title: Expectation of a Constant
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces, with strictly positive coordinate weights summing to $1$, and let $c\in\mathbb R$. The product expectation of the constant function with value $c$ is $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space
All coordinate weights are strictly positive and sum to $1
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$ and $c\in\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_P[c]=c$.
